app.title: Caregiver sharing
app.demoNotice: Demonstration data. The profile used here is an example, not a real person's profile.
app.storageNote: Everything on this page stays on this device. Nothing is sent to a server.
app.loadError: The saved sharing data could not be read, so nothing is shown. Nothing was changed.
owner.heading: Manage what caregivers can see
owner.intro: Nothing is shared unless you grant it. You can narrow or revoke any grant at any time.
owner.form.heading: Grant access
owner.form.caregiverHint: A first name or nickname. Do not enter a phone number or email address.
owner.form.scopeEquipment: An equipment profile snapshot for booking
owner.form.journeyRefHint: The reference code of a journey you already planned. Letters, digits, hyphen and underscore.
owner.form.fieldsHint: A snapshot copies today's values. Later changes to your profile are not shared.
owner.form.expiresHint: Leave empty if access should continue until you revoke it.
owner.grants.heading: Current grants
owner.audit.heading: Activity log
owner.audit.intro: Every grant, change and use of a grant is listed here, oldest first.
audit.reason.wrong_caregiver: the grant belongs to someone else
equipment.walking_with_chair_in_car: Walking, with a chair in the car
caregiver.heading: Shared with you
caregiver.noCaregivers: No one has been granted access yet, so there is nothing to show.
caregiver.empty: Nothing is shared with you right now.
caregiver.emptyHelp: The owner of the profile decides what you can see. Ask them if you need access.
caregiver.noEnd: Access ends: when the owner revokes it
caregiver.snapshotNote: Copied when access was granted. Values shown as Not set were not provided.
error.invalid_input: Check the form. Some details are missing or not allowed.
error.looks_like_contact: Use a name or a short description only, not a phone number, email address or web address.
error.profile_invalid: The profile could not be used for sharing.
error.not_narrowable: That grant cannot be narrowed. Revoke it instead.
error.not_a_narrowing: That change would not reduce what is shared.
error.would_be_empty: That would remove everything. Revoke the grant instead.
error.wrong_caregiver: That grant belongs to someone else.
